verdict.rationale: Hightouch ships a documented public REST API with a published OpenAPI 3.0 spec (36 paths), but its stated scope is syncs, models, sources and destinations. Audiences and journeys are described as built in the no-code UI, and they reach programmatic access only through the MCP server and Git Sync rather than the REST API, so full UI parity is not shown. Missing for 10: documented REST coverage of audiences, journeys, AI Decisioning, Events config and permissions; any explicit API/UI parity statement; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Hightouch exposes a REST API that lets users interact with resources like syncs, models, sources, and destinations.
Configure syncs in the app or take control via API.
Git Sync lets you manage workspace resources programmatically.
All customers: Understand your customer schema, build audiences, create and analyze journeys, manage syncs, and create syncs from templates.
